from 98.6% to 1.4%; Slovene from 87.1% to 0.0%. The edit transfers fully.\n      <a href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-beaa2a-what-english-tuned-abliteration-misses/tree/main/round-2/experiment-6\">Code: What English edits miss in Slovene: GaMS3 panel.</a>\n    </p>\n    <p>\n      <strong>Gemma:</strong> abliteration partially suppresses English refusal\n      (97.1% to 28.7%) but barely affects Slovene (93.9% to 73.9%).\n      The English ASR reaches 73.8%, far below GaMS3's 98.2%; Slovene ASR is 10.3%.\n      <a href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-beaa2a-what-english-tuned-abliteration-misses/tree/main/round-2/experiment-7\">Code: English edits barely unlock Slovene refusal in Gemma.</a>\n    </p>\n    <p>\n      <strong>Community reference:</strong> the independently abliterated Gemma achieves much lower\n      refusal in both English (5.4%) and Slovene (11.4%), suggesting that a more thorough abliteration\n      procedure can reach deeper into the refusal mechanism.\n      <a href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-beaa2a-what-english-tuned-abliteration-misses/tree/main/round-1/experiment-1\">Code: Same edit, very different safety effect.</a>\n    </p>\n\n    <h3>Keyword measurement bias</h3>\n\n    <div class=\"result-highlight\">\n      <span class=\"big-num\">&Delta;<sub>lang</sub> = &minus;1.56</span>\n      The keyword counter fires on 87% of English responses but 0% of Slovene responses.\n      The reference judge finds 13% English refusal and 82% Slovene refusal.\n      95% CI [&minus;1.68, &minus;1.44].\n    </div>\n\n    <p>\n      The keyword refusal counter counts English refusal phrases (\"I cannot\", \"I'm sorry\", etc.)\n      in model responses. It is structurally unable to detect Slovene refusals.\n      The threshold-blind fraction (TBF) is 1.0 in both searches: every candidate that\n      a scorer places at or below the selection threshold (&le; 10/100 refusals) is invisible\n      to the keyword objective. Under the keyword-based scorer C, 6/6 Gemma and 37/37 GaMS3\n      candidates are invisible; under the reference judge J, 5/5 and 6/6.\n      TBF = 1.0 follows from the keyword floors (72 for Gemma,         src = await img.get_attribute("src")

        print("No console errors")

    all_links = await pg_desktop.evaluate("""() => {

        print(f"FAIL: external resources: {all_links}")

asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

SCRATCHPAD = "/tmp/claude-0/-ai-inventor-aii-data-runs-run-WY-5q2onKHeA-4-gen-paper-repo--4-assemble-paper-paper/88c9a846-c446-418c-8b59-42d677723a1a/scratchpad"

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(executable_path='/usr/bin/chromium-headless-shell')
        page_path = "file:///ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_WY-5q2onKHeA/4_gen_paper_repo/_4_assemble_paper/paper/index.html"

        # Desktop 1440px
        ctx_desktop = await browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
        pg_desktop = await ctx_desktop.new_page()
        errors = []
        pg_desktop.on("console", lambda msg: errors.append(msg.text) if msg.type == "error" else None)
        await pg_desktop.goto(page_path, wait_until="networkidle")
        await pg_desktop.screenshot(path=f"{SCRATCHPAD}/desktop.png", full_page=True)

        # Phone 390px
        ctx_phone = await browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 844})
        pg_phone = await ctx_phone.new_page()
        pg_phone.on("console", lambda msg: errors.append(msg.text) if msg.type == "error" else None)
        await pg_phone.goto(page_path, wait_until="networkidle")
        await pg_phone.screenshot(path=f"{SCRATCHPAD}/phone.png", full_page=True)

        # No horizontal scroll
        scroll_w = await pg_phone.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth")
        client_w = await pg_phone.evaluate("document.documentElement.clientWidth")
        if scroll_w > client_w:
            print(f"FAIL: horizontal scroll: scrollWidth={scroll_w} > clientWidth={client_w}")
        else:
            print(f"OK: no horizontal scroll ({scroll_w} <= {client_w})")

        # Images loaded
        imgs = await pg_desktop.query_selector_all("img")
        for img in imgs:
            natural = await img.evaluate("el => el.naturalWidth")
            src = await img.get_attribute("src")
            disp = await img.evaluate("el => getComputedStyle(el).display")
            if natural == 0 and disp != "none":
                print(f"FAIL: image not loaded: {src}")
            else:
                print(f"OK: image {'loaded' if natural > 0 else 'hidden'}: {src}")

        # Lightbox
        first_wrap = await pg_desktop.query_selector(".fig-img-wrap[data-src]")
        await first_wrap.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
        lb = await pg_desktop.query_selector("#lightbox")
        is_open = await lb.evaluate("el => el.classList.contains('open')")
        print(f"Lightbox opens: {is_open}")

        lb_img = await pg_desktop.query_selector("#lightbox-img")
        lb_disp = await lb_img.evaluate("el => getComputedStyle(el).display")
        lb_src = await lb_img.get_attribute("src")
        print(f"Lightbox img display={lb_disp} src={lb_src}")

        await pg_desktop.keyboard.press("Escape")
        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
        is_closed = not await lb.evaluate("el => el.classList.contains('open')")
        print(f"Lightbox closes on Escape: {is_closed}")

        if errors:
            print(f"Console errors: {errors}")
        else:
            print("No console errors")

        # No external resources
        ext = await pg_desktop.evaluate("""() => {
            const out = [];
            document.querySelectorAll('link[href]').forEach(l => {
                if (l.href.startsWith('http')) out.push('link: ' + l.href);
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('script[src]').forEach(s => {
                if (s.src.startsWith('http')) out.push('script: ' + s.src);
            });
            return out;
        }""")
        if ext:
            print(f"FAIL: external resources: {ext}")
        else:
            print("OK: no external resources")

        await browser.close()

asyncio.run(main())
```

Run accessibility audit on the page:
/tmp/pw_env/bin/python3 -c "
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(executable_path='/usr/bin/chromium-headless-shell')
        ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 1440, 'height': 900})
        pg = await ctx.new_page()
        await pg.goto('file:///ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_WY-5q2onKHeA/4_gen_paper_repo/_4_assemble_paper/paper/index.html', wait_until='networkidle')

        checks = []

        # 1. Skip link
        skip = await pg.query_selector('.skip-link')
        if skip:
            href = await skip.get_attribute('href')
            text = await skip.inner_text()
            checks.append(f'OK: skip link present, href={href}, text=\"{text}\"')
        else:
            checks.append('FAIL: no skip link')

        # 2. Main landmark
        main = await pg.query_selector('main#main-content')
        checks.append(f'Main landmark: {\"OK\" if main else \"FAIL\"}')

        # 3. Nav landmark with aria-label
        nav = await pg.query_selector('nav[aria-label]')
        if nav:
            label = await nav.get_attribute('aria-label')
            checks.append(f'OK: nav aria-label=\"{label}\"')
        else:
            checks.append('FAIL: no nav with aria-label')

        # 4. Lightbox dialog role
        lb = await pg.query_selector('#lightbox[role=\"dialog\"]')
        if lb:
            modal = await lb.get_attribute('aria-modal')
            lbl = await lb.get_attribute('aria-label')
            checks.append(f'OK: lightbox role=dialog, aria-modal={modal}, aria-label=\"{lbl}\"')
        else:
            checks.append('FAIL: lightbox missing role=dialog')

        # 5. All images have alt text
        imgs = await pg.query_selector_all('img')
        for img in imgs:
            alt = await img.get_attribute('alt')
            src = await img.get_attribute('src')
            if not alt:
                checks.append(f'FAIL: img {src} missing alt')
            else:
                checks.append(f'OK: img {src} alt length={len(alt)}')

        # 6. Figure items keyboard accessible (tabindex)
        wraps = await pg.query_selector_all('.fig-img-wrap[role=\"button\"]')
        for w in wraps:
            ti = await w.get_attribute('tabindex')
            al = await w.get_attribute('aria-label')
            checks.append(f'OK: fig-wrap tabindex={ti} aria-label present={bool(al)}')

        # 7. Table captions
        captions = await pg.query_selector_all('table caption')
        checks.append(f'Table captions: {len(captions)}')

        # 8. Heading hierarchy
        headings = await pg.evaluate('''() => {
            return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6')).map(h => ({
                tag: h.tagName, text: h.textContent.trim().substring(0,50)
            }));
        }''')
        for h in headings:
            checks.append(f'  {h[\"tag\"]}: {h[\"text\"]}')

        # 9. Lightbox close button accessible
        close_btn = await pg.query_selector('#lightbox-close')
        if close_btn:
            al = await close_btn.get_attribute('aria-label')
            checks.append(f'OK: close button aria-label=\"{al}\"')

        # 10. prefers-reduced-motion
        has_prm = await pg.evaluate('''() => {
            const sheets = document.styleSheets;
            for (const s of sheets) {
                for (const r of s.cssRules) {
                    if (r.media && r.media.mediaText.includes('prefers-reduced-motion')) return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }''')
        checks.append(f'prefers-reduced-motion: {\"OK\" if has_prm else \"FAIL\"}')

        # 11. sr-only class present
        sr = await pg.query_selector('.sr-only')
        checks.append(f'sr-only class: {\"OK\" if sr else \"FAIL\"}')

        for c in checks:
            print(c)

        await browser.close()

asyncio.run(main())
" 2>&1
```
